questions.q: In an ecosystem, the pyramid of energy is always
questions.exp: Energy decreases at each trophic level, so the energy pyramid cannot be inverted.

questions.q: A lichen is an example of which type of ecological interaction?
questions.exp: A lichen is an association of an alga (or cyanobacterium) and a fungus benefiting both.

questions.q: Which gas listed below has the highest Global Warming Potential per molecule over 100 years?
questions.exp: SF6 has a GWP of more than 20,000 times CO2.

questions.q: 18 is what percent of 72?
What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs 5000 at 8% per annum for 2 years?
questions.exp: Difference for 2 years = P(R/100)² = 5000 x 0.0064 = 32 (CI = 832, SI = 800).

questions.q: Milk and water are in the ratio 3 : 2 in 20 litres of a mixture. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1 : 1?
questions.exp: Milk = 12 L, water = 8 L; for 1 : 1 water must be 12 L, so add 4 L.

questions.q: Pipe A fills a tank in 20 minutes, pipe B in 30 minutes, and pipe C empties it in 60 minutes. If all three are open, how long to fill the tank?
Two trains of lengths 100 m and 140 m run in opposite directions at 40 km/h and 32 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
questions.exp: Relative speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s; distance = 240 m; time = 240/20 = 12 s.

questions.q: In a certain code, CLOCK is written as EJQAM. How is TIMER written in that code?
questions.exp: Letters are shifted +2, −2, +2, −2, +2: T→V, I→G, M→O, E→C, R→T, giving VGOCT.

questions.q: Find the next number: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
questions.exp: The series is of consecutive prime numbers; after 13 comes 17.

questions.q: Pascal : Pressure :: Joule : ?
questions.exp: Pascal is the SI unit of pressure and joule is the SI unit of energy (work).

questions.q: Which of the following pairs is the odd one out?
questions.exp: In the other pairs the second number is the square of the first; 9² = 81, not 72.

questions.q: In a row of boys, Ravi is 9th from the left and Sanjay is 14th from the right. If they exchange places, Ravi becomes 20th from the left. How many boys are in the row?
questions.exp: After the exchange Ravi occupies Sanjay's original place, which is 20th from the left and 14th from the right. Total = 20 + 14 − 1 = 33.
